title: Ghosted lead says been busy, send me an email
scenario: Tyler started a refinance application three weeks ago and stopped responding. The rep calls back; Tyler brushes it off as busy and asks for an email, and the rep tries to secure a specific next step.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hi Tyler, it's Grace with Copperleaf Home Loans. We started your refinance application a few weeks back, I just wanted to check in.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh, hey. Yeah, sorry, I've just been super busy. Work's been crazy.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Totally understand. What do you do again?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Logistics. It's peak season, everything's on fire until like January.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh, that tracks. Holidays must be wild.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: You have no idea. I've eaten dinner in my car four nights this week.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oof. Okay, I'll be quick then. Last time we talked you were hoping to lower your monthly payment. Is that still the goal?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, I mean, eventually. Can you just send me something in an email and I'll look at it when I get a chance?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Happy to send an email. The only thing is, the application's just missing two items, so an email probably won't move it forward on its own. Can I tell you what they are? Thirty seconds.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Your most recent pay stub and your homeowners insurance declarations page. That's it.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Oh. That's it? I thought it was a whole thing.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's it. You could probably snap photos of both on your phone.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Okay, yeah, I can do that. Where do I send them?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: I'll text you a secure upload link right after this call. Would tonight or tomorrow morning be easier for you to send them?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Perfect. I'll text you a reminder at seven. Thanks Tyler, hang in there.
